question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**There**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is: *“(3) ______ he kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.”*
 
• The word needed here should indicate **place or position**, referring to one of the baskets.
 
• “**There**” is used correctly to refer to a location — in this case, the basket where the man kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.
 
• Hence, the sentence becomes: *“There he kept a folded quilt and a cauldron.”* — which is grammatically and contextually correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2 – There**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Than** – used for comparison; not suitable here.
 
• **This** and **That** – demonstrative pronouns used to indicate specific objects; they don’t fit grammatically in this sentence.
 
• **There** – correctly indicates a place (the basket) where the quilt and cauldron were kept.
